validation_queries.description: Check for an ainic_* track name per enabled NIC metric (test_ainic.py enables the default 10)
validation_queries.error_message: Fewer distinct ainic_* track names in ROCpd string table than the 10 enabled NIC metrics
validation_queries.query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT string) as count FROM {table_name} WHERE string LIKE 'ainic_%'

validation_queries.description: Check that AI NIC agents are registered with type NIC
validation_queries.error_message: No NIC agents found in rocpd_info_agent — Agent.Type must be NIC, not NULL
validation_queries.query: SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM rocpd_info_agent WHERE type = 'NIC'

validation_queries.description: Check that no agents have NULL type
validation_queries.error_message: Found agents with NULL type in rocpd_info_agent
validation_queries.query: SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM rocpd_info_agent WHERE type IS NULL

validation_queries.description: Check for a NIC PMC description row per enabled NIC metric (test_ainic.py enables the default 10)
validation_queries.error_message: Fewer distinct info_pmc names with target_arch = 'NIC' than the 10 enabled NIC metrics
validation_queries.query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT name) as count FROM {table_name} WHERE target_arch = 'NIC'

validation_queries.description: Check that AI NIC PMCs have a non-NULL agent_id
validation_queries.error_message: Found AI NIC PMC rows with NULL agent_id
validation_queries.query: SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM {table_name} WHERE name LIKE 'nic_%' AND agent_id IS NULL

validation_queries.description: Check that AI NIC PMCs are linked to NIC agents
validation_queries.error_message: Found AI NIC PMC rows not linked to an agent with type NIC
validation_queries.query: SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM {table_name} pmc LEFT JOIN rocpd_info_agent ag ON pmc.agent_id = ag.id AND pmc.guid = ag.guid WHERE pmc.name LIKE 'nic_%' AND (ag.id IS NULL OR ag.type != 'NIC')

validation_queries.description: Check that AI NIC PMCs use target_arch NIC
validation_queries.error_message: Found AI NIC PMC rows without target_arch = 'NIC'
validation_queries.query: SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM {table_name} WHERE name LIKE 'nic_%' AND (target_arch IS NULL OR target_arch != 'NIC')

validation_queries.description: Check that every PMC event has its PMC description row
validation_queries.error_message: Found PMC events without a matching info_pmc row
validation_queries.query: SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM {table_name} event LEFT JOIN rocpd_info_pmc info ON event.pmc_id = info.id WHERE info.id IS NULL
